constraints.description: Fellowships are provided to excellent researchers undertaking international mobility; mobility is a mandatory condition of the action.
The standard duration of European Postdoctoral Fellowships must be between 12 and 24 months.

Global Postdoctoral Fellowships require an outgoing phase of minimum 12 and maximum 24 months in a non-associated Third Country and a mandatory 12-month return phase to a host organisation in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country.
Applications must be made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary in the academic or non-academic sector.

For European Postdoctoral Fellowships, secondments cannot exceed half of the requested duration of the action (excluding any additional period for a non-academic placement) and must be in line with the project objectives.
Secondments cannot take place during the mandatory twelve-month return period to the host organisation in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country.

A non-academic placement of up to six months at the end of the project may be provided at a non-academic host organisation established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country; the request must be an integral part of the proposal, explain the added value, and is subject to evaluation.

If the non-academic placement does not meet the requirements (taking place in an academic organisation or in a Third Country), the proposal is evaluated without taking the placement into account, which might affect the final score.

Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences including digital ones (e.g. generative AI), and foster Open Science, knowledge valorisation, and good scientific conduct such as research integrity.
A Career Development Plan must be established jointly by the supervisor(s) and the researcher and submitted as a project deliverable at the beginning of the action; it can be updated when needed.
Specific eligibility conditions apply to MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships in the research areas covered by the Euratom Research and Training Programme.

Admissibility conditions are described in Annex A and Annex E of the Work Programme General Annexes; proposal page limits and layout are described in Part B of the Application Form in the Submission System.
Award criteria, scoring and thresholds are described in Annex D of the Work Programme General Annexes; the submission and evaluation process is described in Annex F.
